actions.description: Publish one std_msgs/Float64 to the ActuatorCommand subscription. The plugin writes the value into d->ctrl once and leaves it there until another message arrives, so it stays the actuator's control input. The receipt proves only that rosbridge accepted the publication; it does not prove motion, target arrival or stopping.

facts.text: The pinned branch is the ROS 2 branch of MujocoRosUtils.
The README's feature list states that the plugins retrieve body poses and camera images, send commands to actuators and apply external forces through ROS interfaces.
ClockPublisher defaults topic_name_ to the absolute /clock when the MJCF plugin config is empty.
ClockPublisher creates a rosgraph_msgs::msg::Clock publisher on topic_name_.
PosePublisher defaults the pose topic to mujoco/<body name>/pose and the velocity topic to mujoco/<body name>/vel; the sample explicitly sets them to /pose and /vel.
PosePublisher creates a geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped publisher and a geometry_msgs::msg::TwistStamped publisher.
ActuatorCommand defaults an empty topic_name to mujoco/<actuator name>; the sample overrides it with /camera_pan.
ActuatorCommand creates a std_msgs::msg::Float64 subscription on topic_name.
ActuatorCommand::compute spins its own executor once and, when ctrl_ is not NaN, writes it into d->ctrl[actuator_id_] and sets ctrl_ to NaN; while ctrl_ is NaN it leaves d->ctrl unchanged.
ActuatorCommand::reset has an empty body.
SensorPublisher maps a one-dimensional sensor to MsgScalar and creates a mujoco_ros_utils::msg::ScalarStamped publisher for it.
SensorPublisher creates the concrete mujoco_ros_utils::msg::ScalarStamped publisher on topic_name_ for scalar sensors.
The sample MJCF attaches ActuatorCommand to the camera_pan actuator and configures the topic /camera_pan.
The sample MJCF declares the camera_pan hinge joint with range -90 90 and a position actuator named camera_pan on that joint.
The sample MJCF configures ClockPublisher with publish_rate 100 and the pose and rangefinder publishers with publish_rate 30.
The sample MJCF configures PosePublisher's pose_topic_name and vel_topic_name as /pose and /vel.
The sample MJCF declares a box_rangefinder sensor and configures SensorPublisher's topic_name as /box_rangefinder.
ScalarStamped carries a std_msgs/Header and one std_msgs/Float64 value.
ImagePublisher publishes a sensor_msgs::msg::Image with encoding rgb8 for color and 32FC1 for depth; this package does not expose the camera plugin.
ExternalForce subscribes to mujoco_ros_utils::msg::ExternalForce; this package does not expose the force plugin.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned observations; no MuJoCo step, pacing or state-hash replay

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free canned transport: it answers the declared /clock, /pose, /vel, /box_rangefinder and /camera_pan endpoints and runs no MuJoCo physics, plugins, sensors or wall-clock loop
all clock, pose, twist and rangefinder values are placeholders; they do not advance with the MuJoCo simulation or establish a trajectory
the package exposes no acknowledged stop, reset or step endpoint; the plugin reset callbacks are internal, and a Float64 topic publication is transmission-only
the sample's optional output_tf PosePublisher and its frame broadcasts are not exposed

the ActuatorCommand write persists: the plugin writes d->ctrl once and then leaves it unchanged, so a published value stays the actuator's control input (the sample's camera_pan is a position actuator); the fake records only the publication

the plugin topics publish only while MuJoCo steps the model; while the simulate application is paused or not stepping, the four resource reads fail NOT_READY at their 2000 ms timeout and every command still publishes but completes only after those reads (reviewer probe on the fake)
the camera color/depth images and CameraInfo, the ExternalForce subscription, the PointStamped, Vector3Stamped and QuaternionStamped sensor variants, /box_framepos and /box_framequat are NOT COVERED

operator_required.reason: the pinned plugin and sample model state no numeric range or physical unit for the Float64 written to d->ctrl; the operator supplies the deployment envelope

safe_state.description: No acknowledged ROS stop is declared: the pinned plugins create only publishers and subscriptions, ActuatorCommand's reset is empty and a Float64 publication is transmission-only, so the package does not claim a safe state it cannot confirm.
